description: Number of times a user clicked through to the site from a search result.
Number of times the site appeared in search results for a given query or row.
Click-through rate: clicks / impressions, ranging from 0.0 to 1.0. Ratio metric — computed from clicks and impressions; never stored raw (AD-4).

Average position of the site in search results for the row. GSC API field name is 'position'; canonical rename is 'average_position'. Non-additive: must be impression-weighted when aggregating across rows. Platform contract field carried from the module manifest; official-name divergence (if any) is documented in ROLLOUT_NOTES.md and adjudicated by the 25.6 live probe.
The search query string that users entered. Returned as a key when 'query' is in the dimensions list.
The final URI of the page that was shown in the search result (landing page URL). Returned as a key when 'page' is in the dimensions list.
The country from which the search originated, as a 3-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code (e.g. 'fra', 'gbr'). Returned as a key when 'country' is in the dimensions list.
The device category of the user performing the search. One of: DESKTOP, MOBILE, TABLET. Returned as a key when 'device' is in the dimensions list.
The date of the data in YYYY-MM-DD format (Pacific Time). Returned as a key when 'date' is in the dimensions list.
Hourly breakdown key (ISO-8601 timestamp). Only available when dataState='hourly_all' is set in the request. Returned as a key when 'hour' is in the dimensions list.

The search surface (type parameter in the request body). One of: web (default), image, video, news, discover, googleNews. Stamped on every raw row during extraction; not a grouping dimension returned in keys[].

The specific search result feature that triggered the impression (e.g. RICHRESULT, AMP, WEBLIGHTRESULT). Returned as a key when 'searchAppearance' is in the dimensions list. Cannot be grouped with any other API dimension; daily grain requires per-day single-dim requests.
